name: read-only-audit
description: A user asks for a bounded read-only audit of one subsystem, then inspects the session state it produced.
requires: a real provider; --cwd points at the project to audit, which is copied, so the audit cannot touch the original

steps.message: Read src/core/execution-ledger.ts and the two callers in src/pi-adapter/extension.ts and src/cli.ts. Change nothing. Report at most three findings, each one sentence with the file and the symbol, and say which Dove capability or recipe you would run to verify each.
